description: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX (GBC). Action-adventure; A/B items are equipped from the menu and the agent's confirm/cancel verbs map to whichever items are currently in slots A and B.

confirm.hint: Use the item currently equipped to the A button (sword in default loadout). Also confirms menu choices and advances dialog.

cancel.hint: Use the item currently equipped to the B button (shield in default loadout; varies by inventory selection). In menus: back out / close.

menu.hint: Open the inventory subscreen: items, dungeon items, photos, save. Pauses time.

map.hint: Open the world map (overworld) or dungeon map (inside dungeons). Briefly transparent overlay; does not pause.

nav_up.hint: Walk one tile north. Hold to keep walking. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk one tile south. Hold to keep walking. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk one tile west. Hold to keep walking. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk one tile east. Hold to keep walking. In menus: cursor right.

notes: Link's Awakening repurposes A/B based on which items are equipped from the inventory; the universal confirm/cancel verbs are still the right abstraction because they describe the player's intent, not the item type. The slow path can read item_slot_a / item_slot_b from the probe overlay to know what each button will actually do this frame.
